value.rationale: Natural smallest positive exponent at the split prime 3 in a classical maximal quaternion order, directly addressing sharpness of the 2026 at-most-three existence theorem. Trace rigidity is a structural necessary condition and explicit exact partner/inner orbit spectrum; it is not a random slice or a mere echo of the known 96 norm-three shell count. The finite classification is complete and may serve as a concrete benchmark for more general norm-power generation phenomena.
